Fixed and shipped in 4e2ee37 (persian-claude-gui/server.py + test_units.py).

Root cause: CLI_ENVELOPE_RE = ^\s*<[a-z][a-z-]+> at server.py:628 matches <bash-input>/<bash-stdout> exactly as it matches the CLI's self-talk envelopes (<system-reminder>, <command-name>, ...), so _normalize_transcript_event() dropped both records and a session started in the real TUI replayed with no shell rows at all.

Fix: the two bare-string user records jump the filter the way <task-notification> already does, and -- because in a real transcript the command and its output are TWO CONSECUTIVE records, while the wrapper's own bash_message() parks all three tags in ONE message -- they are REJOINED into that single-message shape. splitBashBlocks() (static/js/render.js) anchors its regex on <bash-input>, so a lone stdout record would otherwise have rendered as prose with the literal tags showing.

Pieces: BASH_INPUT_PREFIX / BASH_OUTPUT_PREFIXES constants, new bash_envelope_text(), folding in _append_transcript_event(), the envelope branch in _normalize_transcript_event(), and read_session() + read_agent_events() both routed through the folding helper. user_prompt_text() deliberately unchanged, so a `!` line still never becomes a session's title or preview.
